column1: Reason codes: PREP prep trim, SPOIL out of date or spoiled, OVER over-produced, ORDER wrong order made, RETURN customer sent it back, BREAK breakage, STAFF staff food or drink, COMP comped to a guest.
Cost at cost price, not menu price, and total the sheet weekly against sales.
Keep the sheet where the waste happens. A log in the office is a log nobody fills in.
